key_insight: Vendi Anomaly Scores detect anomalies by measuring how removing a sample changes dataset diversity, capturing both local redundancy and global structure.
engineering_relevance: VAS offers non-parametric anomaly detection with no hyperparameter tuning and reported linear scaling in dataset size.
method: Measure dataset diversity using the Vendi score.
Score each sample by its effect on diversity when removed.
Adapt automatically to the data’s spectral structure rather than density estimates or partitioning heuristics.
evidence_signal: The authors report state-of-the-art performance across 148 embedding benchmarks from 10 source datasets and 4 embedding architectures, plus robustness to increasing contamination and scale in ImageNet experiments.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify similarity construction or computational costs beyond dataset-size scaling; check these for your representation and deployment scale.
paper_title: Vendi Anomaly Scores for Efficient and Accurate Anomaly Detection
